turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm trying to fix this bug in my data pipeline where it's choking on credit card numbers.
Hi Alan. Are you using Presidio for the anonymization step? That's a common place for regex conflicts.
Yeah, I am. It works fine for phone numbers, but it completely misses most credit card entries.
Have you checked the default recognizer settings? Sometimes the stock models need tuning for specific entity types.
I looked at the docs. It turns out stock Presidio achieves 11.1% recall on CREDIT_CARD entities and 50% on PHONE_NUMBER entities. That explains why it's missing so many.
That makes sense. You might need to add custom recognizers or fine-tune the existing ones to improve that coverage.
I'll try that. Also, do you know if the weather is going to rain tomorrow? I have a picnic planned.
I don't have real-time weather data, but you might want to check a local forecast app to be sure.
Good point. I'll check it later. Thanks for the help with the Presidio issue.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need help with the custom recognizers later.
